factors.name: AIConnectivityBreadth
factors.basis: Marvell's September 2026 issuer releases describe an end-to-end AI data-center connectivity portfolio and new 2nm optical technology demonstrations spanning scale-up, scale-out and scale-across interconnect domains.

risks: Portfolio breadth and technology demonstrations do not prove customer share, product-specific revenue or return on R&D investment.
unknowns: No customer-specific volumes, pricing, market share or incremental revenue were disclosed in the releases.
Alpha retains factor scoring and valuation authority.

factors.name: AdvancedNodeRoadmapExecution
factors.basis: The 2026-09-21 ECOC release extends Marvell's stated optical roadmap to multiple 2nm connectivity solutions after prior 5nm/3nm generations, providing current evidence of roadmap delivery cadence.

risks: Demonstration readiness can precede production qualification and meaningful revenue.
unknowns: Production ramp dates and customer qualification status for each 2nm solution were not quantified.

observedFacts: Marvell described AI connectivity products across PCIe scale-up switching, CXL memory, storage and Ethernet/optical connectivity.
The release frames connectivity as a constraint on bandwidth, latency, power and AI infrastructure utilization.
Marvell announced 2nm optical technology demonstrations for AI data-center infrastructure at ECOC 2026.
The portfolio includes optical PAM4, coherent-lite PAM4/IMDD and ZR/ZR+ coherent solutions targeted at higher-speed, lower-power interconnects.

recommendation: Reuse as current source-addressed thesis/catalyst and execution evidence while keeping customer economics and production conversion unknown.
